answer: Sybil farms mint cheap worker IDs. An applicant locks 23.6 marble coins for a 4-hour dawn window and files eleven packets with a 5-node violet beacon, passing at 3-of-5. Each packet binds a device attestation and a 90s nonce; clones reusing the attestation or arriving in an 8-minute burst are dropped. Cost: a failed window burns the 23.6; honest work refunds 21.8 and burns 1.8, so 800 Sybils lock 18,880 coins and collapse on one device. Verification: public merkle of dawn-shift IDs plus an attestation bloom. Failure: violet-beacon collusion or bloom false positives go to a 6-day 4-of-7 replay.
